name: Resource Manager
description: Scan the mounted folder or the current file: find resources (e.g. images in ./images or ./assets) that are NOT referenced by any Markdown, and references whose local files are MISSING. Also lists resources referenced by multiple notes, and checks the current file's attachments against other notes. Ported from obgnail/typora_plugin resource_manager.
author: AlexShyXie (ported from obgnail/typora_plugin/resource_manager)
